summary.headline: Cascade Residential Services secures $927K in annual savings; $426K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners drove a strategic sourcing program across HVAC OEM, supplies and uniforms, delivering $426,000 in hard-signed annual savings to date and identifying a further $501,000 now moving through final contracting. Major wins include executed national rebate agreements with Carrier and Rheem, a multi-vendor plumbing supplies RFP, and a uniform consolidation that will cut rental costs by 43 %. Additional opportunities with Lennox, Johnstone and Interplay are in client review and forecast to bring total annual savings to $927,000.
